file_reviews.assessment: Source inspection of package Demo 3 host engine and receipt verifiers. Assesses verify_receipt_bytes recomputing 30-cell digest chains, pre-decrement fuel accounting, rollback on empty/move-after-VERIFY/malformed element batches, exhaustion to TERMINAL/FUEL_EXHAUSTED, and omission of fuel/arm script validation in package verifier.

Source inspection of Demo 3 host unit tests. Confirms test_packaged_matrix_receipt_verifies_without_a_certificate, test_verify_receipt_bytes_rejects_forgeries_and_empty, test_move_after_verify_rolls_the_whole_batch_back, test_empty_batch_consumes_fuel_and_rolls_back, test_malformed_element_ids_do_not_commit, and test_repeated_refusals_consume_fuel_and_exhaust.

Source inspection of Rust port of Demo 3 host engine. Confirms pre-decrement fuel accounting, rollback without fuel refund across empty and invalid batches, transition to FUEL_EXHAUSTED at fuel 0, and passing unit tests.
Source inspection of baseline Demo3 matrix receipt generation and canonical digest chain recording over 30 cells.
Source inspection of Paper 003 Section 4 and 4.1, documenting host transactions, fuel exhaustion, and receipt verification boundaries.
Claim ledger rows P3-04 (baseline receipt verifier scope), P3-06 (package host exhaustion), and P3-07 (package receipt verifier boundary and omission of fuel/arm script checks).

claims.statement: verify_receipt_bytes recomputes each of the 30 cells' digest chains from the initial digest, checks fuel and scripted arm decisions, and refuses {}, schema changes, chain breaks and certificate claims.
dependencies: Repository receipt verifier checking 30-cell execution matrix digest chains and transaction constraints.
Specification refusing unpopulated receipts, schema field modifications, hash chain discontinuities, and unadmitted certificate claims.
claims.limits: Applies to the audited baseline receipt verifier scope over the 30-cell matrix; digest-chain verification establishes state transition continuity without asymmetric signatures or producer authentication.

claims.statement: In the package host every refused batch (move after VERIFY, empty, malformed id) costs one fuel unit and rolls back; after initial fuel F refusals the host is TERMINAL with FUEL_EXHAUSTED.
dependencies: Package Demo3HostEngine pre-decrement fuel accounting decrements remaining fuel by 1 per batch attempt.
Atomic state rollback restoring semantic state upon validation failure while preserving the consumed fuel decrement.
Exhaustion trigger transitioning to TERMINAL with FUEL_EXHAUSTED when attempt fuel reaches zero.
claims.limits: Applies to integer initial fuel F >= 0 in package host and verified Rust parity; bounds processed batch attempts, not wall-clock execution time or network bytes.

claims.statement: The package verify_receipt_bytes refuses empty input, {}, certificate labels, non-hex event bytes and unrecomputed digest edits, and does not check fuel or arm scripts.
dependencies: Package verify_receipt_bytes implementation recomputing SHA-256 digest chains from initial digests across 30 cells.
Selective validation logic omitting checks on step-level fuel counts or scripted arm decision sequences.
claims.limits: Applies to the package verify_receipt_bytes implementation; confirms that receipts with recomputed digest chains pass even when fuel values or arm decisions are altered, as long as certificate labels are omitted.
